errors.text_span: дясната показва стотни от 0% до 120%, с единици в проценти
errors.evidence: The word "стотни" (hundredths) is an awkward and potentially confusing translation for percentages or percentage points, even though it's clarified later in the phrase. It should just state percentages.

errors.text_span: Колоните, в сив и бял райе, обозначават вноса
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the columns (plural) are striped and represent import. In fact, there are two types of columns: striped for import ("внос") and solid gray for export ("износ"). The export series is completely omitted from this part of the description.
The description claims the value for 2004 is approximately 20%. The striped bar for import ("внос") in 2004 is at approximately 55%.

errors.text_span: Линията, оцветена в черно, представя обема на търговията и започва от едва над 50% през 2004 г., достига пик малко над 65% през 2008 г., след това намалява до под 50% през 2012 г., и се увеличава до около 60% през 2019 г..
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly reads the line chart data from the left y-axis (0-70%) instead of the correct right y-axis (0-120%). For example, it states the value in 2019 is around 60%, but according to the right axis, it is approximately 105%.

errors.text_span: Последната линия, в тъмносив цвят, представя износа
errors.evidence: The chart does not contain a second line representing export ("износ"). Exports are represented by solid gray bars. The description hallucinates a data series and its visual representation.

When describing the hallucinated line for exports, the description claims a peak of 55% in 2008. The actual export data (the solid bars) shows a value of about 42% in 2008, with peaks occurring in other years (e.g., ~52% in 2013 and 2017).
When describing the hallucinated line for exports, the description claims a value of 30% in 2012. The actual export value (solid bar) in 2012 is approximately 50%.
The description of the legend is incomplete. It fails to mention the legend entry for "Износ" (export), which is represented by the solid gray fill.
